title: The New Year's Eve job and the guitarist who quit
summary: On a New Year's Eve job Joe raised the pay, Chip refused to play, and Joe scrambled for a saxophonist; Brady Smith sent his cousin Leo Montrell.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
